cases.case_label: Alu c.4052_4053ins328 in exon 4 of RP1 (Korean RP)
cases.mechanism_detail: The known RP1 exon 4 Alu insertion (c.4052_4053ins328, frameshift p.Tyr1352Alafs) was detected by WGS in three Korean RP patients, each compound heterozygous with a truncating RP1 variant (c.4196delG or c.6181del); maternal inheritance shown in available families.
cases.quote: We report three cases of Korean retinitis pigmentosa (RP) patients with compound heterozygous variants including Alu element insertion in the RP1 gene
